name: Figgy Dowdy
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Figgy Dowdy, also known as Madge Figgy, is a Cornish folkloric figure. Old custom in Cornwall gave this name to the spirit who watches the holy well located at Carn Marth. Dolls were baptized there through an unusual rite. Because goddesses once ruled most such sites, some believe the name misreads Cornish words for the reaper goddess or for the good goddess of the scythe.
